# PyrexxAI

> PyrexxAI is an AI-driven digital transformation agency for MedSpas, dental clinics, and therapy practices in the US.
> We specialize in custom AI voice receptionists, clinical web development, and database reactivation campaigns.

## Company
- Founded by: Clifford Bulya
- Headquarters: United States (Delaware incorporated)
- Contact: hello@pyrexxai.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/PyrexxAI

## Core Services

### 1. AI Voice Receptionist
- Done-for-you AI voice receptionist implementation (not a SaaS tool)
- Live in 14 days from kickoff to production
- Integrates natively with Jane App, Mindbody, eClinicalWorks and other EMRs
- Handles unlimited concurrent calls (zero hold times)
- Business Associate Agreement (BAA) included with all clients
- Pricing: $1,500 implementation + $1,000/month platform management

### 2. Website Building & Optimization
- Blazing fast, SEO-optimized clinical websites built on Next.js
- HIPAA-compliant lead capture pipelines
- Built for high mobile conversion

### 3. Database Reactivation
- Automated SMS/Voice outreach to dormant patient lists
- 100% Risk-Free, Commission-Only model (Pay only for shows)

## Target Clients
- Medical Spas (MedSpas)
- Dental Practices
- Therapy and Mental Health Clinics
